title: Home Comfort Financing — Open Account Limit per Customer
content:
**Credit policy.** A customer may hold more than one Home Comfort Financing account, one per installation project, up to the plan's limit on accounts held at once (2 accounts on every plan) in approved, active or delinquent status at the same time. Declined, withdrawn, expired, paid-off and charged-off accounts do not count toward the limit.

The holding limit is 2 accounts per customer.

## Which accounts count

| Account status | Counts toward the limit of 2 |
|---|---|
| approved | yes |
| active | yes |
| delinquent | yes |
| declined | no |
| withdrawn | no |
| expired | no |
| paid off | no |
| charged off | no |

An application that is still being decided is not among the counted statuses.

## Illustrations (hypothetical customers)

- A customer holds one active account and one paid-off account. One account counts; the customer is below the limit of 2.
- A customer holds one delinquent account and one approved, not yet funded account. Two accounts count; the customer is at the limit of 2.
- A customer holds one active account, one expired approval and one withdrawn application. One account counts.

Each account finances one installation project; a second account is for a different project.
